family_name: Bradford Supertel Faced - Heavy Duty Foil

spec.description:
Bradford Supertel Faced - Heavy Duty Foil is a high-density
(32kg/m3) glasswool insulation blanket and board factory-laminated with a Heavy
Duty Thermofoil reflective aluminium foil facing. Engineered for commercial and
industrial applications where superior thermal and acoustic performance is
required at minimal thickness, it is widely utilized for internal and external
HVAC duct lining, acoustic enclosures, and concrete under-soffit insulation. Its
non-combustible glasswool core and puncture-resistant Heavy Duty foil provide a
clean, reflective, and airtight vapor barrier.
features:

properties at minimal thickness

Factory-laminated with Heavy Duty Thermofoil
puncture-resistant reflective aluminium foil facing

Forms an effective vapour
barrier and clean, light-reflective surface finish

Non-combustible glasswool
core complying with AS 1530.1

AS/NZS 1530.3 (0/0/0/0-1)

Maximum operating service temperature up to 150°C
(faced)

Manufactured from bio-soluble FBS-1 glasswool containing up to 65%
recycled glass
Resistant to moisture penetration and fungal growth

Zero
Ozone Depleting Potential (ODP) and low VOC emissions

Available in
thicknesses from 25mm to 100mm (R0.8 to R3.0)

install:
Clean sheet metal duct or
concrete slab surface to ensure it is free from dust, oil, and moisture

Weld
or adhere insulation stick pins to duct or substrate at 300mm to 400mm centres

Impale Supertel Heavy Duty Foil blanket or board over the pins with the foil
facing outward

Secure in place with speed clips / retaining washers pushed
firmly over pins
Butt all insulation seams tightly together

Seal all
joints, seams, and pin penetrations using matching Bradford 493 Reinforced
Aluminium Foil Tape

Use a plastic squeegee to firmly press tape down,
ensuring an airtight, continuous vapour seal
selection_checklist:
Confirm application (HVAC duct wrap, acoustic enclosure, or concrete soffit
lining)

Confirm required thermal R-value under NCC Section J (e.g. R1.2 for
internal ducts, R1.5/R2.0 for external ducts)

Verify 32kg/m3 density
requirement for acoustic damping and structural integrity

Ensure matching reinforced aluminium foil tape (Bradford 493)
is ordered
accessories: Insulation stick pins and speed clips
limitations: Maximum continuous service temperature of facing is 150°C

Protect from
exterior weather and rain until metal cladding or outer jacketing is installed

Tape all penetrations to prevent vapor ingress and condensation formation
behind the foil

not_for:

where air velocities exceed limits

Uncovered outdoor rooftop ductwork without protective metal
cladding
retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Supertel Faced - Heavy Duty Foil is a 32
kg/m3 high-density glasswool insulation blanket and board factory-bonded with a
puncture-resistant Heavy Duty Thermofoil aluminium facing. Engineered for
commercial HVAC duct wrapping, equipment enclosures, and under-soffit linings,
it delivers thermal ratings from R0.8 to R3.0 (25mm to 100mm) while forming a
robust vapour barrier that stops condensation. Featuring a non-combustible
glasswool core under AS 1530.1 and early fire hazard ratings of 0/0/0/0-1, it
provides fire-safe, durable thermal and acoustic protection for commercial
services.
